Superbuy spreadsheet search guide

Start with a product name, Weidian ID or photo. Find the right catalog category, then check warehouse QC, ordering steps or shipping costs.

Superbuy spreadsheet and Weidian finds

Browse Weidian listings with seller photos, reference prices and direct links to each product page.

Start with the full catalog and filter by product type. Compare listings with the original Weidian page to confirm the seller, item ID and available variants before opening Superbuy.

Find a Weidian product by ID or link

Paste a Weidian item ID, original listing URL or a Superbuy link that contains the Weidian URL.

For a Weidian URL, copy the number after itemID or paste the whole link. Try item 7405460467 to see how the catalog connects the result to its product page and seller link.

Example English searches

  • weidian item id search
  • superbuy weidian link search
  • find weidian product by url

Superbuy image search for similar products

Upload a product photo or cropped screenshot to find visually similar results in the site’s image index.

Crop out unrelated backgrounds when possible. The browser compares your image with indexed seller photos, saved QC photos and other site images. Check the matching product’s item ID and variant to verify the result.

Example English searches

  • superbuy image search
  • weidian reverse image search
  • find weidian products by photo
Search by image

Superbuy QC and warehouse photos

See how seller images and saved warehouse QC photos are labeled on a product page.

Saved QC photos are historical references when available. On your own Superbuy order, check the warehouse photos for the size tag, color, condition and included pieces before submitting international delivery.

  • superbuy warehouse photos

How to buy from Weidian with Superbuy

Follow the illustrated guide from the Weidian listing to order submission, warehouse inspection and parcel delivery.

Open the Weidian listing through the product’s Superbuy button and verify the variant and quantity. Review the order, inspect the item once it reaches the warehouse and choose an eligible shipping route for the parcel.
